info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Rollover API
Factset Gets the Latest Relative Rollover Date for the Database.

items.docs:
Gets zero relative date and last update time for FactSet databases. The dates represent the date that the rollover event happened; the date and time is in **eastern time zone**.

Depending on the ids requested and their respective regions, a requested startDate or endDate used in the various Prices API may reflect different previous close dates.
